observations.fujifilm_velvia_50: One publication-embedded controlled 24-patch film-versus-digital display-chain observation exists. Original pixels, reusable data rights, independent roll holdout and separated process/scanner evidence are absent; the frozen 2x2 residual also failed.
observations.kodak_portra_400: One public but unlicensed same-session package provides a strongly registered digital-chart versus Portra 400 print-scan observation. The fixed chart affine strongly regresses the RA4/Epson natural observation and only weakly improves Noritsu, proving scanner/print nuisance is material; independent roll and repeat-scan evidence are absent.
observations.kodak_ektar_100: No comparable rights-cleared same-scene colour observation is currently bound. Existing unpaired images, external emulation controls, datasheet priors and uniform-grain scans cannot fill this lane.

next_data_sequence: Acquire the first rights-cleared same-scene Ektar 100 digital/film observation with process and scanner receipts.
Acquire independent Velvia 50 original pixels with roll and scanner holdout.
Acquire Portra 400 same-negative repeat scans plus an independent roll holdout.
scientific_conclusion: The project is not at zero real observation, but it is at zero admissible stock-specific K=1 training lanes. Velvia 50 and Portra 400 each contribute one bounded mechanism or nuisance observation; Ektar 100 is the first missing paired-colour lane. More proxy algorithms cannot repair these data deficiencies.
claim_ceiling: Executable strongest-current-observation matrix for Velvia 50, Portra 400 and Ektar 100. No stock response, calibration, K=1 operator admission, product profile, multi-stock completion or cross-stock preference claim.
